links.outcome: Agreement of LLM-computed HEART score versus APP-computed score, each compared with blinded physician adjudication
links.effect: Weighted kappa with adjudicators was 0.67 for the LLM and 0.66 for the APP. The LLM's mean HEART score was higher (5.06 vs 4.69 adjudicators, 4.23 APP). No significant difference in 60-day MACE prediction (all p > .05).
links.quote: Among the remaining 551 participants, agreement by Cohen's weighted kappa between the LLM and adjudicators was 0.67 which was similar to the agreement of 0.66 between the APP and adjudicators.

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation of GPT-4's accuracy in calculating the HEART score from chart notes compared to clinical adjudicators and routinely documented scores.
